principle: Academy population exists independently of player observation. Population structure is resolved before persistent individuals are materialized.
rules: Every active cadet occupies exactly one cadet-class membership slot.
The player cadet occupies one real cadet slot.
Canonical/authored cadets occupy real population slots and may not be layered on top of aggregate counts.
Tier C to Tier B materialization consumes the same latent slot and does not increase population.
Tier B or A identities never demote back to anonymous Tier C.
Temporary physical absence does not remove a cadet from cohort membership.
Academy population numbers are campaign/era/content data; this contract does not assert one universal canon total.
Visitors are accounted separately from enrolled cadets and assigned staff.
Population changes require explicit membership/assignment/arrival/departure events.
Species or culture context may constrain population composition but never directly defines personality, morality, competence or relationship state.
Player proximity does not create, delete or rebalance Academy population.
